fullTextZH: 对老爷爷和老奶奶有很多很多孩子。
fullTextEN: The old grandpa and grandma have many, many children.

fullTextZH: 第六个、第七个、第八个、第九个、第十个。
fullTextEN: The sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, and tenth.

fullTextZH: 现在所有的孩子都很大了。
fullTextEN: Now all the children are grown up.
So they are not at home.

fullTextZH: 现在老爷爷老奶奶有很多很多时间。
fullTextEN: Now the old grandpa and grandma have a lot of time.
Now they are not busy every day.

fullTextZH: 他们每天有很多很多时间。
fullTextEN: They have a lot of time every day.
Yes, they read books every day.

fullTextZH: 第一年老爷爷老奶奶很开心。
fullTextEN: In the first year, the old man and old woman were very happy.

fullTextZH: 第二年老爷爷老奶奶也很开心。
fullTextEN: In the second year, the old man and old woman were also very happy.
The old lady said to the old man:
Yes, the old lady wants a pet.
Hmm, do you want a pig?
The old man said: Do you want a bird?
The old man said: Do you want a dog?
Very tired, don't want a dog!

fullTextZH: 鱼？鱼听起来有点无聊，无聊！
fullTextEN: Fish? Fish sounds a bit boring, boring!
The old grandpa said: Do you want a snake?
I am afraid, I am afraid of snakes!
Sounds good, I want a cat!
I'll go, I'll go find the cat.
